blk-b1.title: B1 · Confirm real ElevenLabs cost per audio minute
blk-b1.note:
• What is the real ElevenLabs EUR per audio minute on the chosen plan?
• At the assumed €0.08, a 2-minute call costs about €0.16, which is over the €0.10 budget in the business plan.
• Done when AUDIO_EUR_PER_MIN is set to the real price, or the per-call budget is raised and written down.

blk-b2.title: B2 · Run 10 demo calls on staging to measure latency
blk-b2.note:
• Who runs 10 demo calls on staging, so we can measure p95 time from stop-speaking to first audio?
• Then run: npm run qa:latency -- --live <shop>.
• Needs a person, a storefront and a microphone. This is one of the biggest risks to the Oct 24 date.

blk-b3.title: B3 · Run the 20-call voice test matrix
blk-b3.note:
• Who runs the 20-call voice matrix with a real mic: German and English, desktop and mobile, barge-in and background noise?
• Log each result in docs/qa/results-2026-10-23.md.
• Needs a human. This is one of the biggest risks to the Oct 24 date.

blk-b4.title: B4 · Throwaway Neon branch to test migrations
blk-b4.note:
• Approve a throwaway Neon database branch so prisma migrate deploy can be run against a fresh database.
• The migrations have never been applied end to end because no local Postgres or Docker was available.
• Done when migrate deploy reaches the final schema on the branch, and the branch is deleted afterwards.

blk-b5.title: B5 · Hosting decisions for staging and prod
blk-b5.note:
• Answer the 4 questions in docs/deploy/ENVIRONMENTS.md §5: staging vs prod setup, monthly cost ceiling, who may push to production, and Neon branching.
• Zorc is ready to act as staging, following the runbook, once this is answered.
• This blocks deployment of the Shopify app.

blk-b6.title: B6 · Support email and docs URL for the App Store listing
blk-b6.note:
• Decide the support email address and the public docs URL for the Shopify App Store listing.
• Both are required fields in the app review checklist (docs/app-review-checklist.md).
• Done when both are live and added to the listing.

blk-b7.title: B7 · Run Shopify billing in test mode, then live
blk-b7.note:
• A person runs Shopify billing in test mode, then live: €99, €249 and €499 plans with a 14-day trial.
• Check that the trial, upgrade, downgrade and cancellation paths all work.
• This must be done by a human with store access, and it gates the launch.
